title: Home beyond a binding future picture

captions.physics: Carrying out a chosen domestic idea
captions.energy: Waiting for an ideal future comfort
captions.emotions: Clinging to the dream’s material proof

meaning: Your domestic idea preserves freedom when a future picture does not require every object and condition once promising to realise it to be retained.
text: You can move towards comfort through directed effort: seeing a goal, gathering essentials and completing practical work. The Chariot in the physical position of Muladhara describes action for two. The Star in energy tests your footing through an ideal future home that makes today seem insufficient. The Devil in emotions holds to the objects and conditions confirming that picture. A dream can therefore restrict choice: releasing an acquisition or simplifying the idea feels like losing the possibility of freer life, although its established image already demands too much.

For example, you collect crockery for future beautiful dinners together. Space for ordinary meals shrinks, yet rare pieces are hard to release because they seem to hold the promise of another home. **A dream need not retain everything that once symbolised it in the present.** An altered future image can preserve meaning without every earlier purchase. Directed action helps life again, instead of domestic space maintaining material proof of an ideal evening still ahead.

The difficulty is bringing the dream closer through another object from its picture. Possessions increase, free space shrinks and waiting remains. You do much for the future while becoming more bound to its former version. Support grows through keeping a desired direction while changing its form, so today’s shared life need not continually pay for the promise of future comfort.
